scope: all seven G20/C60 studies and every registered curve, same immutable original ledgers
profit_unit: initial NAV dollars; net asset PnL equals portfolio wealth change
holding_definition: continuous positive unit position from entry to full exit; all buys/sells and notional allocated fees included; terminal positions censored; not FIFO trade lots
loss_reason_features: observational entry/exit r21/r63 and SMA20/SMA50, asset/year/max-drawdown attribution, fees that flip gross-positive closed episodes negative; not causal proof
weight_only_policy: keep exposure and gain/loss day diagnostics; never invent missing fills/cash/position episodes
dedup: same line and byte-identical manifest-bound ledger analyzed once, every exposure retained
stop: one complete frozen inventory, reconcile all cash/unit curves; no retrospective loser blacklist or future-selected entry filters
